items.title: A health insurance agency's journey from pilot to full-time voice AI agent
items.excerpt: eHealth uses Regal's 'Alice' voice AI agent to prescreen Medicare callers during open enrollment; it answers every call instantly, scores 77% 'exceptional' satisfaction and drives a 27% higher purchase rate than the outsourced human screeners it replaced.

items.title: McDonald's disputes reports that it uses AI to set prices
items.excerpt: McDonald's vehemently denied using AI to set or change menu prices, saying its pricing tool gives restaurant-specific recommendations and doesn't change prices in real time or by daypart; franchisees make the final call.

items.title: Tinuiti Unveils Bliss Point MCP Server, Pioneering Open Measurement Access for AI Agents
items.excerpt: Agency Tinuiti opened its Bliss Point measurement layer to AI agents via an MCP server, letting ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or a client's own agents query normalized cross-channel media performance and measurement data under client permissions.

items.title: AI마다 추천 브랜드·판매처 제각각…AI 쇼핑, 브랜드 경쟁도 바꾼다
items.excerpt: Jellyfish's Share of Model study across 8 categories in 4 markets found ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Alexa for Shopping recommend very different products and retailers (ChatGPT ~80% of measured recommendations); it added SKU-level 'Shopping Optimization' to track why AI agents pick products.

items.title: Pinterest launches Beauty Guides to turn inspiration into action
items.excerpt: Pinterest's new Beauty Guides combine visual understanding with an LLM to turn hair and nail Pins into personalized guides with salon instructions, similar looks and relevant products, part of its 'Pinterest Intelligence' push from inspiration to purchase intent.

items.title: TBWA코리아, AI 시대 맞춤 모듈형 마케팅 솔루션 'AIM by TBWA' 선봬
items.excerpt: TBWA Korea launched AIM, a modular service that diagnoses how a brand is represented inside AI answers (GEO) and feeds that into media, PR, content, customer acquisition and CRM in a seven-stage loop, responding to zero-click AI discovery.
items.axis: search/discovery shift (weak: agency GEO service, borderline vendor promo)

items.title: AI는 소스를 만들고, 사람은 완성한다 — 14년 차 광고 디자이너의 AI 활용법
items.excerpt: A 14-year ad designer explains how generative AI now produces the source imagery for ad creatives while humans finish typography and layout, because fully automated AI banners still look 'AI-made'.
